0022600104.text: The Heat (0-1) sit fourth in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, and 14th in the East after losing their last game at home. The Hornets (1-1) are third in the Southeast, one game back, and eighth in the East, and they will be without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, after surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Miami won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though Charlotte beat the Heat 136-106 in their last meeting, on March 17, 2026, in Charlotte.
